column7: \lemma cos_negative {z : Complex} : cos (negative z) = cos z
\lemma sin_negative {z : Complex} : sin (negative z) = negative (sin z)
\lemma cos_+ {x y : Complex} : cos (x + y) = cos x * cos y - sin x * sin y
\lemma sin_+ {x y : Complex} : sin (x + y) = cos x * sin y + sin x * cos y
\lemma cos_minus {x y : Complex} : cos (x - y) = cos x * cos y + sin x * sin y
\lemma sin_minus {x y : Complex} : sin (x - y) = sin x * cos y - cos x * sin y
\lemma euler {z : Complex} : exp (i * z) = cos z + i * sin z
\lemma pythagoras {z : Complex} : cos z * cos z + sin z * sin z = {Complex} 1
\lemma cos-sum-to-product {x y : Complex} : cos x - cos y = negative (2 * sin ((x + y) * ratio 1 2) * sin ((x - y) * ratio 1 2))
\lemma sin-sum-to-product {x y : Complex} : sin x - sin y = 2 * cos ((x + y) * ratio 1 2) * sin ((x - y) * ratio 1 2)
\lemma cos-fromReal {x : Real} : cos x = {Complex} rcos x
\lemma sin-fromReal {x : Real} : sin x = {Complex} rsin x
